rules.sentence: Tricuspid valve surgery is indicated for symptomatic severe tricuspid stenosis accompanied by tricuspid regurgitation (eg, rheumatic and carcinoid heart diseases), as percutaneous balloon tricuspid commissurotomy may worsen regurgitation.
